sources.title: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) for LLMs - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) is a method of adapting a pre-trained language model using a smaller dataset containing labeled examples. The model learns to produce the desired output for a given input, improving its performance on a specific task or type of instruction.

sources.title: From SFT to GRPO: A Practical Guide to Modern LLM Fine-Tuning ...
sources.snippet: Learn how SFT, DPO, PPO, GRPO, PEFT, LoRA, and QLoRA fit together in modern LLM post-training, when to use each technique, and how to combine them effectively.

sources.title: Fine-tune a model with supervised fine-tuning in Microsoft Foundry
sources.snippet: Prerequisites A Foundry resource or project with an SFT-supported model and training region. The Foundry User role for training, or the Foundry Owner role if you also deploy the fine-tuned model.

sources.title: A Coding Guide on LLM Post Training with TRL from Supervised Fine ...
sources.snippet: In this tutorial, we walk through a complete, hands-on journey of post-training large language models using the powerful TRL (Transformer Reinforcement Learning) library ecosystem. We start from a lightweight base model and progressively apply four key techniques: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), Reward Modeling (RM), Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), and Group Relative Policy Optimization ...

sources.title: New ENCFORGE Ransomware Targets AI Model Files in Langflow RCE Attack
sources.snippet: JADEPUFFER exploits Langflow CVE-2025-3248 to deploy ENCFORGE ransomware against AI model weights, vector indexes, and training data on the host.
